Directed by Tony Award winner Jerry Zaks, it stars Andrew Rannells (Gutenberg!), Megan Hilty (Death Becomes Her), Tituss Burgess (Oh, Mary!), Harry Hamlin (Anne Rice’s Mayfair Witches) and Lisa Rinna (Days of Our Lives).
